Ava (AE): MerchantGate wants a short POC to swap vendors. asks: API parity for function-calls, predictable billing, and a signed security questionnaire. can we scope blockers?
Ben (SE): short list: tokenization differences, stop-sequence behavior, and function-call wrapper shape. recommend: small adapter shim + 100 representative prompts SxS.
Rita (Security): red flags: EU data residency, customer-managed KMS, audit/log access, deletion attestation. Dedicated or Private required for CMK + residency.
Omar (Platform): infra options: Hosted with CMK envelope (limited), or spin Dedicated in eu-west-1. Dedicated sandbox ~48-72 hrs. will need IP allowlist + short-lived certs for staging.
Ava (AE): procurement prefers pay-per-use but may sign 3mo commit for price cap. need sample pricing for 200k->800k tokens.
Ben (SE): action: ask them for 100 prompts (they have 15 now). we'll run diff report: token delta, semantic drift, function name mismatches, latency p50/p95.
Ava (AE): sample vendor payload they sent:
```
POST /v1/respond
Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY
{ "model":"tx-lite", "prompt":"Summarize Feb transactions", "call_functions":true }
```
Ben (SE): adapter plan: translate `call_functions` -> our `functions` array and normalize returned payloads (robust JSON parsing). also add token-count shim for POC billing parity.
Rita (Security): I'll start drafting questionnaire answers; need their DPA and network egress spec.
deploy-bot: Note: Dedicated provisioning requires internal ticket. ETA 3 business days once ticket created.
Omar (Platform): deliverables: adapter prototype repo (2 days), runner + diff report (1 week), pricing options & SOW draft (Ava).
Ava (AE): OK. I'll consolidate and send plan + ask for full prompt set. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
